notes.title: Zombie Mountain and Flick stick
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added Time Attack mode Zombie Mountain.
[*] Added new faster control method called Flick stick invented by JibbSmart. It is meant for controllers with gyros.
[*] Added Flick stick with auto aim to allow Xbox pad users to try flick stick. The auto aim is experimental.
[*] Steam Input for joypads, with rumble support.
[*] New Unity Input System for mouse and keyboard.
[*] Much more range and granularity for mouse and gyro sensitivity.
[*] Added quick restart for time attack modes.
[*] Refresh is VSynced again.
[*] Upgraded to a newer version of Unity, I hope this helps with the saving issue someone has.
[/list]

notes.title: World Stats Screen and Splodge Royale Advert
notes.content:
I have added an 8MB trailer advertising my game Splodge Royale.  It is my best game so far and I have spent 3 years on it.

Added a World Statistics screen which shows the total number of Zombies killed by everyone since Steam Stats were added, also a daily count too!

Saving procedure slightly changed.

notes.title: Splodge Royale is now only $1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Splodge Royale now costs $1.
[*] First person painter party game.
[*] I recently added a new gyro aiming mode which allows the gun arm to move independently of the direction you are looking. You need a controller with a gyro to access this feature.
[*] Lots of different versus and coop modes.
[*] Up to 4 local players.
[/list]

notes.title: Frame Rate and FOV
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Increased frame rate to 240Hz for the main character.
[*] Some particles are now also 240Hz and have been changed.
[*] VSync is now always off, this game gets more frequent input updates that way.
[*] The Field of View can be set from 60 - 120 degrees measured horizontally.
[*] Medal graphics are higher res.
[/list]

This game runs in fullscreen windowed mode and is dependent on your desktop's refresh rate.

notes.title: Evac Hints, Volume Levels, Gyro
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Evacuation notification improved to show clearer direction hint.
[*] Sound effects and music volume level added in menu.
[*] Added a reset camera to horizon button to help Gyro control on joypads.
[*] Added SteamInput mappings that make use of the Gyro, including the Steam Controller.
[*] Separated joypad stick sensitivity and mouse sensitivity, gyro mappings use the mouse sensitivity.
[*] Rearranged the Options menu and it now loops.
[*] Swapped the bonus objective on level 1 and 2 (Thank you Peacook).
[/list]
